Does this change affect how interface code uses the design tokens of `@wordpress/theme`, which are the `--wpds-*` CSS custom properties? Answer no when the change only changes the internal styles of a component in the design system packages `@wordpress/components`, `@wordpress/ui`, `@wordpress/theme`, `@wordpress/base-styles` or `@wordpress/icons`.
